title: Copy to SVG
reason: Historical request asks to copy selected artwork as SVG; Varve has a corresponding clipboard action.
varveAssessment: Supported: selection-to-SVG clipboard action and success/failure announcements in packages/editor/src/actions/createActionHandlers.ts; SVG export in packages/editor/src/export/compositor.ts.

title: Improve sponsorship page
reason: The report asks for changes to tldraw’s sponsorship page.
varveAssessment: No Varve editor workflow implicated.

title: Multiplayer
reason: Requests presence and document sync; linked MVP PR explicitly listed missing collaboration features.
varveAssessment: Collaboration is a stub in packages/editor/src/components/Collab/; no syncing backend. Preserve local-first/offline constraints if considered.

title: Save current file
reason: Requests protection before loading another file; Varve has a dirty-document termination guard but route coverage needs verification.
varveAssessment: Canonical dirty-document termination dialog/coordinator exists; route coverage for every open/replace action was not traced.

title: NPM package
reason: Requests publishing tldraw as an embeddable npm package.
varveAssessment: No Varve embed-package request implied.

title: VS Code extension
reason: Requests a VS Code extension for tldraw documents.
varveAssessment: No VS Code extension route in Varve.

title: Refactor design system
reason: Internal tldraw design-system refactor without an app behavior report.
varveAssessment: No Varve behavior implicated.

title: Scroll back to content
reason: The empty-page recovery request is tied to tldraw’s page model and has no direct Varve reproduction.
varveAssessment: Varve has a tested empty-canvas state; tldraw empty-page recovery is not equivalent to its infinite-canvas model.

title: Flash of dark mode when loading
reason: PR #50 says it fixes the dark flash and includes a refresh/light-theme check; Varve behavior is not established by that source.
varveAssessment: Theme system exists; first-paint boot surface was not visually verified here.

title: Paste does not work
reason: The issue only guesses a regression source and gives no steps or observed paste behavior.
varveAssessment: No reproduction to map; clipboard implementation is in packages/editor/src/clipboard.ts.

title: Toast notifications
reason: The request is for async completion feedback; Varve announces SVG-copy outcomes, while visible-toast coverage is unknown.
varveAssessment: copyAsSvg announces outcomes; visible-toast behavior for all asynchronous operations was not verified.

title: How the references work?
reason: Asks a TypeScript configuration/path-reference question.
varveAssessment: No Varve workflow implicated.

title: Consider LiveBlocks alternative for security
reason: The reporter objects to third-party SaaS dependency for self-hosted multiplayer; Varve’s local-first/privacy direction makes this a future acceptance constraint.
varveAssessment: Varve is local-first; the privacy/self-hosting concern is an architectural constraint for any future collaboration work.

title: Translation Error: zh-CN
reason: Requests missing Chinese strings and language names; Varve has English menu strings only.
varveAssessment: Varve menu localization is English-only; no matching translation catalog is present.

title: Increase Width of Pages Dropdown
reason: User reports long page names clipped; the corresponding Varve layout was not visually inspected.
varveAssessment: Page navigation exists; long-label clipping was not visually inspected.

title: Blank screen, stuck on Loading.
reason: The VS Code extension maintainer published a candidate fix and the reporter confirmed it.
varveAssessment: No VS Code extension path.

title: Image cropping crashes in child frame or window
reason: The issue requires a React portal rendered into an Electron child-window realm; no Varve embed contract was found.
varveAssessment: Reported React portal into a child-window realm is not an advertised Varve host arrangement.

title: [Feature Request] Spline arrows & lines like excalidraw.
reason: The request is specifically for editable curved waypoint arrows; the thread says line waypoints already existed in tldraw.
varveAssessment: Connector/line tool behavior needs a focused capability check; no waypoint-arrow reproduction was run.

title: Arrow Texts cannot have monospace font style
reason: tldraw said an internal monospace-label fix was coming, but no release or PR was cited.
varveAssessment: Connector label font behavior was not verified.

title: Menu gets stuck
reason: Intermittent menu hover defect lacks browser/OS details and maintainers could not reproduce it.
varveAssessment: No matching menu hover reproduction.

title: pinch to zoom broken on safari
reason: Safari 16.4 pinch issue was confirmed fixed upstream; Varve runtime was not tested.
varveAssessment: Varve has touch-pinch navigation state and input pipeline; Safari runtime was not exercised.

title: Share feature not available
reason: The reported multiplayer URL later worked; no persistent defect was established.
varveAssessment: No hosted multiplayer share service; collaboration remains stubbed.

title: Ctrl + S Not Working
reason: The beta’s Ctrl+S behavior differed from the user’s overwrite expectation; Varve’s real file-save flow needs end-to-end confirmation.
varveAssessment: Save, Save As, and Save a Copy are distinct; no real open-edit-save-existing-file sequence was run.

title: File > New Missing
reason: tldraw said File > New was added; Varve has a new-document entry point.
varveAssessment: New-document entry points and File menu exist; UI visibility was not reproduced.

title: Language Changes
reason: This is a locale preference bug; Varve currently has no locale-selection state.
varveAssessment: No locale-selection state; current menu labels are English-only.

title: Open file on beta not working
disposition: real-browser validation candidate if symptom recurs
reason: tldraw cites fixes but does not supply browser/OS or reporter confirmation.
varveAssessment: Picker wiring has a unit test; native browser picker behavior was not exercised.

title: Add measurement tools
reason: A commenter names measured site plans, landscape architecture, cabinetry, and interiors, directly adjacent to precise layout/print workflows.
varveAssessment: Measured layout is adjacent to print/layout workflows; scale-aware units and geometry were not established.

title: Add measurement tools
reason: The empty body and sole comment point to #1243.
varveAssessment: Same potential as #1243; duplicate retained independently.

title: Transparent background not working in PNG export
reason: The title says transparency while the body focuses on whitespace; upstream replies do not distinguish alpha from cropping.
varveAssessment: PNG alpha versus content-bound cropping remains unresolved; output was not inspected.

title: Exception thrown when drawing a long line
disposition: adjacent performance case; missing API not found
reason: The reported Android Chrome 96 crash says structuredClone was absent; Varve core does not use that API, but the long-stroke workload is adjacent.
varveAssessment: No structuredClone use found in Varve editor core; large-document stroke workload remains untested.

title: When there are too many strokes, the response of writing is not sensitive
reason: Reports pen latency/curve quality degradation at high shape counts, including a later report above 1,000 shapes.
varveAssessment: Adaptive rendering/input paths exist; no high-shape stylus latency/fidelity benchmark was run.

title: Make "Loading assets" screen dark
reason: The issue reports light-mode loading under dark theme; acknowledgement is not evidence of a fix.
varveAssessment: Varve boot loading surface was not screenshot-checked in dark mode.

title: Cannot open tldr file on iOS iPad
reason: Reporter confirmed a staging fix for an iPad Safari file picker; Varve mobile support is not established.
varveAssessment: iPad Safari file picker behavior and mobile web support scope were not tested.

title: Line glitches
reason: Android touch-emulated stylus strokes reportedly fold and wobble; the last reply asks for a retest without confirmation.
varveAssessment: Varve stroke input path is relevant; no Android touch-emulated stylus capture/reproduction was made.

title: Storage for custom shapes and objects
disposition: candidate; distinguish generic stash from mockups
reason: Requests reusable user objects; linked #1345 proposes a collections panel, while Varve’s verified library is mockup-specific.
varveAssessment: Varve has a mockup template library, not a verified arbitrary-selection personal stash.

title: Can't drag canvas on laptop with touch display
reason: Firefox touchscreen pan was reportedly addressed; Varve’s touch pointer support does not itself prove this path works.
varveAssessment: Touch pointer classification and navigation state exist; Firefox touchscreen behavior was not tested.

title: Open tldraw-beta projects in tldraw
reason: The request depends on tldraw version conversion and hosted read-only links, neither established as a Varve contract.
varveAssessment: Cross-version tldraw conversion and hosted read-only links are not Varve contracts.

title: Easier hand tool access, either via right click or keyboard shortcut
disposition: no change justified by source evidence
reason: The proposed wheel/right-button behavior is explicitly an expectation experiment; Varve already supports Space hand and standard wheel/pinch navigation.
varveAssessment: Varve uses Space spring-loaded hand and its wheel/pinch navigation classifier; no change justified by this report.

title: Shape menu flashes when text is highlighted
reason: Firefox menu flicker has a video link; upstream only says it believes the problem fixed.
varveAssessment: Potential text/selection overlay issue; linked video was not played and no Varve reproduction was made.

title: "Save as" and "Open" not available ?
reason: tldraw beta file-system work was still in progress; Varve already exposes Open, Save, and Save As.
varveAssessment: File > Open, Save, and Save As routes exist in Menubar and usePersistence.

title: Keyboard shortcuts for color selection
reason: Color shortcut PR #1595 was closed unmerged during style-menu redesign; user suggestions remain unresolved.
varveAssessment: Shortcut palette exists; per-color shortcut support/conflicts were not verified.

title: Export function should be on file menu
reason: Export discoverability and filename defaults are subjective; tldraw debated placement and retained it.
varveAssessment: Export menu actions exist; first-time findability and filename behavior were not tested.

title: CAPSLOCK + SHIFT
reason: The reporter says the behavior was user error.
varveAssessment: Reporter withdrew the issue; no Varve defect.

title: Anchor locator
reason: The request and linked old issue distinguish canvas anchors, page links, and following diagram connections.
varveAssessment: Varve has pages and navigation/prototype concepts; persistent canvas anchors and cross-page shape links were not mapped.

title: Better feedback during loading
reason: Thread reports 10+ second large-image upload/render and explicitly asks for visible loading feedback.
varveAssessment: Import progress UI exists; post-placement image decode/first-frame feedback was not traced.

title: Tldraw embed crashes in incognito mode
reason: Firefox private browsing exposed persistence limitations; tldraw says it ultimately notified users about possible loss.
varveAssessment: Browser private-mode persistence failure behavior was not tested.

title: Better font for Korean
reason: Korean/English rendering looked poor; a suggested font prompted licensing concerns.
varveAssessment: Font rights metadata exists in clipboard logic; Korean glyph fallback and licensed font coverage were not assessed.

title: "Tip of the day" feature
disposition: already covered by existing learning flows
reason: Varve has contextual/Did-You-Know hints; related #1304 discusses discoverability but does not establish a distinct daily-tip need.
varveAssessment: Existing Did-You-Know and contextual-help systems provide matching optional learning flows.

title: Suggestion for improvement: paste should pick a different position
reason: Merged PR #2852 chose selection-UI blink for paste-in-place rather than moving artwork; Varve behavior was not checked.
varveAssessment: Varve duplicate tip says duplicate is offset; paste-in-place behavior and selection feedback were not inspected.

title: Can you add Thai langauge ?
reason: Requests Thai translations; Varve has no supported-locale plan.
varveAssessment: No supported-locale plan is declared; menu localization currently English-only.
